nodes.label: Bootstrap-to-revenue spine
nodes.rationale: India cost base gives 4-6x runway-per-dollar; product already built so money would only buy growth and a data feed — fundable from MRR + savings at ~$5-7K/mo team burn.

nodes.label: At most one $150-300K angel SAFE (for introductions, not cash)
nodes.rationale: Take only after the first charge clears, capped ~10%, SAFE only — the one good reason is an operator-angel whose broker/acquirer intro is worth more than the money.

nodes.label: No priced seed (misaligned with sub-$70M exit)
nodes.rationale: A seed VC underwrites $1B outcomes; a $30M exit loses them money, and a 15-25% priced round hands ~$4.5M of founder value to buy growth producible for free. Raise-then-sell-at-$30M is the worst of both worlds.

nodes.label: Clean founder-heavy cap table as acquisition asset
nodes.rationale: Fewer signatures, no liquidation-pref waterfall, faster close; worth roughly $3-4M per founder in avoided dilution on the modeled $30M outcome.

nodes.label: Dilution math ($10M vs $5.5M vs $4.5M per founder)
nodes.rationale: On the same $30M exit: 100% bootstrapped ~$10M each; recommended SAFE+ESOP ~$8M; forced seed ~$5.5M; heavy raise ~$4.5M — more ARR lifts exit price, not multiple.
